building.description: You are inside a building, a well house for a large spring.

road.description: You are standing at the end of a road before a small brick building.

valley.description: You are in a valley in the forest beside a stream tumbling along a rocky bed.

slit.description: At your feet all the water of the stream splashes into a 2-inch slit in the rock.

depression.description: You are in a 20-foot depression floored with bare dirt. A strong steel grate is set in the ground.

entrance.description: You are in a small chamber beneath a 3x3 steel grate to the surface. A low crawl leads inward.

cobbles.description: You are crawling over cobbles in a low passage. There is a dim light at one end.

debris.description: You are in a debris room filled with stuff washed in from the surface.

awkward_canyon.description: You are in an awkward sloping east/west canyon.

bird_chamber.description: You are in a splendid chamber thirty feet high. A passage leads south, another west.

pit_top.description: You are at the top of a small pit breathing traces of white mist.

hall_of_mists.description: You are at one end of a vast hall stretching forward out of sight to the west. Rough stone steps lead up and down.

hall_of_mountain_king.description: You are in the Hall of the Mountain King, with passages off in several directions. A fierce green snake bars the way!

west_side_chamber.description: You are in the west side chamber of the Hall of the Mountain King. A passage continues west and up.

south_side_chamber.description: You are in the south side chamber. The walls are covered with murals.

y2.description: You are in a large room with 'Y2' painted on a rock. There is a passage to the plover room.

plover_room.description: You are in the Plover Room. A tight passage leads to the northeast.

cave.note: Simplified Colossal Cave: 17 rooms connected by passages. The grate between depression and entrance requires keys. The snake in Hall of the Mountain King requires the bird. Rooms below pit_top require the lamp.

player_token.note: The adventurer's position marker, placed at current room node.

keys.note: Set of keys found in the building. Unlocks the steel grate.

lamp.note: Brass lantern found in the building. Required for dark rooms.

bird.note: A little bird in the bird chamber. Scares away the snake.

snake.note: A huge green fierce snake. Blocks passages in the Hall of the Mountain King.

grate.note: A locked steel grate between the depression and the entrance.

move.constraint: target node is adjacent to current node
move.definition: Move the adventurer to an adjacent room.

pick_up.constraint: item is at current room AND item.portable == true
pick_up.definition: Pick up a portable item from the current room into inventory.

drop.definition: Drop an item from inventory into the current room.

use_keys.constraint: keys in inventory AND player at depression or entrance
use_keys.effect: grate.locked = false; passage between depression and entrance opens
use_keys.definition: Use keys to unlock the steel grate.

use_bird.constraint: bird in inventory AND player at hall_of_mountain_king
use_bird.effect: snake removed; passages from hall_of_mountain_king open
use_bird.definition: Release the bird to scare away the snake.

grate_blocks.trigger: move from depression to entrance OR entrance to depression
grate_blocks.definition: The locked grate blocks passage between the depression and the entrance.

snake_blocks.trigger: move from hall_of_mountain_king to west_side_chamber or south_side_chamber
snake_blocks.constraint: snake is not present at hall_of_mountain_king
snake_blocks.definition: The fierce snake blocks passage deeper into the cave.

darkness.trigger: move into a room with light == false
darkness.definition: Dark rooms require the lamp. Without it, the adventurer is lost.

library.all_treasures_at_building: all treasures (gold_nugget, diamonds, silver_bars, rare_coins, ming_vase) are at building node AND player is at building
